items.title: Paul Shaffer interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, August 24, 2023
items.q: After “Godspell” I met him on the next show I did

ctx.x: I should fast forward a little bit. When you got into the SNL band and were there for a while, did the writers start to recognize that you would be a useful character in skits? Like the Star Wars thing on the train? How did that occur?

Well I was sort of sizing things up and saying to myself how can I get on camera. You know it totally was. Whether it was subconscious or whether I knew what I was doing or not, that’s just the kind of kid I was, kind of repressed I guess on the outside but dying to break out. And well a couple of crazy things happened. The first year, no even before you know my first job in town was a Broadway show, “The Magic Show.” Steven Schwartz, the Broadway composer, brought me in to town. Because I had played “Godspell”…
Well you found yourself on camera in part of —
